title: If You Own Silver or Gold, You Need to Watch This Signal Closely
speaker: Jordan Roy-Byrne (host) with guest Vince Lanci (GoldFix)

macro_themes.view: Roy-Byrne sees a weekly double bottom in gold/S&P at the rising 40-month MA, signalling capital could rotate back from stocks into gold over the coming weeks and months.
Both see a peak or start of a topping process in the 2-year and real 10-year yields, which historically marks important gold bottoms.
Lanci expects a possibly final Fed hike in October, with the market pricing the Fed as done and the economy cooling.
Lanci says hedge-fund fiscal-year liquidation weighs on metals Sep-Nov, with bottoms usually between mid-October and late November and buying from mid-November to mid-January.
Lanci thinks the AI credit bubble is starting to pop, with Nasdaq weak relative to the S&P and investors drawn to ~5.5% bonds.

macro_themes.theme: Gold back into the monetary system
macro_themes.view: Both expect gold to return to the monetary system (e.g., Judy Shelton's gold-linked bonds), which Lanci says could double or triple gold over 5-10 years.

calls.condition: Possible false breakdown toward ~3,900 around an October Fed hike, then a slingshot; Lanci doesn't expect gold below 3,900 before mid-November.
calls.reason: Gold/S&P double bottom at the 40-month MA plus a peak in 2-year and real yields and a weakening dollar; seasonal low due mid-October to late November, then buying returns.
calls.quote: I don't think we get below 3,900 between now and say the middle of November... go to 4,600. That's that's a 10% move.

calls.reason: Silver has held $55 support several times; it needs time after a huge move and likely won't retest its ~120 high for 2-2.5 years, but a ~20% move in the next 6 months is plausible.
calls.quote: be thankful for a 20% move in the next 6 months

calls.reason: Lanci is invested in miners (Newmont, GDX, West Red Lake) and expects miners to lead, with a 30-40% move in silver stocks if silver rises 20% in 6 months.
calls.quote: miners will probably lead the way this time... you'll probably have a 30 or 40% move in silver stocks.

calls.reason: Yields have been rejected three or four times in 15 days and gapped lower, a triple-top-like structure; the 2-year may top around 5% and the market sees the Fed nearly done.
calls.quote: the bond market seems to be topping.

calls.reason: Lanci sees the dollar working into a bear flag as yields peak.
calls.quote: the dollar seems to be possibly working into a bear flag now to go lower.

calls.reason: Lanci says the AI credit bubble is starting to pop and money is leaving tech; gold/stocks ratio bottom implies capital moving from stocks to gold.
calls.quote: The AI credit bubble is starting to pop.

notes: No date stated in transcript; listing '22 hours ago' gives 2026-10-21 (could be 10-20). Lanci (guest) gives most specific levels; Roy-Byrne's own view is the gold/S&P double bottom and yield peak. TNX row actually reflects 2-year and real 10-year yields; 5.0 is the 2-year 'top out around 5%' level. Silver price 55 is the support level Lanci cites as roughly current.
